question: Does router.pad_contacts = inside_pad (a trace end whose cap, the disc of half the trace width around the end point, overlaps a same-net pin's pad on that layer connects to the pin, and one whose cap overlaps a same-net trace's copper on that layer, a T junction, connects to the trace, KiCad's rule) keep the KiCad-unconnected total within N02's totals rule (accept no-regress, a correctness fix: the router's connectivity disagrees with KiCad's on boards laid out in KiCad) of center (Java's rule), on boards routed with their existing tracks kept, with no via in a pad, no copper below the minimum and no new DRC error?
engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main at the run (amendment 3; N04.1-N04.4 landed; one release build for every arm, its --version git sha in N04.3's note); profile enhanced (the default) for both arms, so they differ only in router.pad_contacts

center.engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main at the run (amendment 3; N04.1-N04.4 landed; one release build for every arm, its --version git sha in N04.3's note); profile enhanced (the default) for both arms, so they differ only in router.pad_contacts
center.what: baseline: Java's rule, a trace end touches a pin only at its centre (unset)

inside_pad.engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main at the run (amendment 3; N04.1-N04.4 landed; one release build for every arm, its --version git sha in N04.3's note); profile enhanced (the default) for both arms, so they differ only in router.pad_contacts
inside_pad.what: candidate: KiCad's rule for pins and trace T junctions, the end's cap overlapping the pad or the other trace's copper (vias keep Java's)

pairs_rule: the verdict pair is judged by the totals block with the hard and guard metrics below (freerouting-dev gate --prereg on a records file written from the graded numbers)

boards.why: the boards where the contact rule can matter: laid out in KiCad, with tracks that the router keeps

grading: WSL KiCad 10.0.7 for every row, one job at a time: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh --keep-tracks <input> -- <arm command>. When two arms' sessions are byte-identical the session is graded once. A row grade.sh cannot grade (exit 2) falls back to the router's unrouted count, as the totals block's signal says. The canary-pwr sessions go to target/canary-handoff/ for canary's official grade

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py on the routed board (vias of the session only; a via the input already had is not counted)
metric_definitions.drc_real: kicad-oracle's drc_real (router-attributable: the input's own items subtracted)
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: kicad-oracle's unconnected_items of the routed board
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's final unrouted count (its log); the signal for a row KiCad could not grade
metric_definitions.router_initial_unrouted: the router's unrouted count before routing (its log, 'Auto-routing stage started ... for N unrouted items')
metric_definitions.kicad_input_unconnected: kicad-oracle's input_unconnected_items (the board as given, tracks kept); N04.1 asks that it equal router_initial_unrouted
metric_definitions.vias: vias of the routed board (kicad-oracle's copper.vias)

keep_rule: if the verdict passes, N05 adds router.pad_contacts=inside_pad to ENHANCED; otherwise inside_pad stays an off-by-default value with these numbers
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per row; no reruns with other settings
not_registered: the KiCad demos video, vme-wren and jetson-agx-thor-baseboard (size)
the via half of N04's rule (a trace end inside a via's pad, a via centre inside a pin's pad): not implemented until KiCad's connectivity on the demo boards is checked
boards routed from scratch (tracks stripped): the rule can matter only where tracks the router did not lay end off a pin's centre
seen_before_registration: N04.1's correctness test on fixtures/Issue690-ecc83.dsn (the demo-ecc83-pp row's export, wires byte-identical): the router's count before routing, center 10, inside_pad 3 under the first rule (end inside the pad) and 1 under the amended rule (end cap overlaps the pad); after routing with tests/pad_contacts.rs' settings (20 passes, optimizer on, a Testing profile, not this registration's command) center 6, inside_pad 1 under both rules. No KiCad grade, and no other board, under either arm. Under amendment 2's rule (T junctions, N04.4) the same test gives inside_pad 0 before routing (KiCad's 0) and 0 after routing; center unchanged

decision_table.pass: enhanced gets pad_contacts=inside_pad; N05.3 line; DIVERGENCES Profile enhanced entry
decision_table.fail: pad_contacts stays off in both profiles, numbers in N04.3

amendments.reason: rule widened again before any graded number (N04.4): a trace end whose cap overlaps a same-net trace's copper on its layer (a T junction) connects to that trace, as KiCad connects it; the amended rule left ecc83's last open connection, a track ending on another track's inner corner
